qualified_scope: Signed macOS arm64 CLI and three packaged helpers; 23 direct compiled native cases, two local provider-authority cases, one offline component-repair case and four protocol entrypoints.
limits: Qualification covers only the named macOS arm64 private-stdio consumers with loopback providers and disposable homes.
No desktop startup, installation, live-provider/account acceptance, physical audio, performance, live billing, release, tag or publication.

Saved conversations continue on their configured saved provider after a changed default. This is native admission; Decodex adds no automatic routing policy. The conditional legacy recovery action still requires an actual native modelProviderMismatch.

The original explicit-recovery proof retains its original artifact and limits. The new artifact does not emit a default-mismatch refusal, so this run qualifies saved-provider continuation and unchanged refusal-only local authority rather than claiming a new native refusal flow.
Direct compiled libtests and explicit CLI paths avoid Nextest CARGO_BIN_EXE substitution. Native sessions clear inherited environments and resolve signed helpers from the exact package.
No upstream source tests ran locally. Official CI results and read test bodies remain distinct. Unresolved generic CI failures do not count as passes or create Decodex repair work.
Shared MCP enablement still requires the official fix and its existing four exact-artifact sharing regressions. Deferred controls and workflows remain unselected.
Previous qualification retains its original artifact, selectors and limits. Missing historical proof is not reconstructed or treated as current execution.

historical_scope.limits: Original feature qualification limits remain in the contract catalog and Git. The saved-provider admission change has an explicit current contract and separate execution receipt.

helper_provenance.native_helpers: Built with the CLI from the bound official source tree by scripts/codex_package/cargo.py.

development_preparation.import_command: DECODEX_CODEX_DEVELOPMENT_RUNTIME=<exact signed candidate package> cargo +stable make prepare-codex
development_preparation.signing: Use the existing configured identity and unchanged official entitlements. Only codesign uses the host Keychain environment; import and runtime test homes are disposable.

retained_source_inclusion.limits: Ancestry proves inclusion only. Source review and the actual named artifact executions supply the retained-consumer proof.

official_ci.scope: Reuse each official check result as reported. Failed, cancelled and unfinished checks are not passes. No aggregate generic CI acceptance is claimed.
official_ci.consumer_decision: Exact selected macOS artifact regressions determine retained compatibility. Unconsumed generic failures are diagnostic limits.

source_validation.limits: Each commit record binds the relevant diff, implementation, test bodies and current consumer or exclusion. Titles, paths, schema and ancestry do not substitute for source review.

decodex_validation.limits: No Rust production source changed. No broad app/provider/upstream source suite was required. Each execution uses the recorded source, exact artifact/helpers, entrypoint, toolchain and feature inputs.
